descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Technical Business Analyst SAP S/4HANA con una forte esperienza funzionale e tecnologica in Finance & Management Control (FI/CO), Product Management (MM), Sales & Distribution (SD) e SAP Fiori ecosistema.
Responsabilità chiave

• Raccogliere e analizzare le esigenze aziendali delle parti interessate interne e proporre soluzioni il più vicino possibile alle caratteristiche standard di SAP S/4HANA.

• Consiglia gli utenti alle buone pratiche SAP S/4HANA.

• Contribuisci alla definizione di soluzioni che soddisfano le esigenze aziendali e soddisfano gli standard SAP.

• Partecipa a progetti di evoluzione e trasformazione SAP S/4HANA.

• Impostare e personalizzare moduli FI (GL, AP, AR e AA), CO, MM e SD.

• Sostenere le campagne UAT e contribuire a rilasciare le attività di gestione.

• Assicurare la qualità, la durata, la scalabilità e la sostenibilità delle soluzioni, rispettando gli standard di prodotto e le esigenze aziendali definite dal cliente.

• Mantenere documentazione funzionale e tecnica.

• Fornire supporto alle applicazioni, diagnosticare problemi e risolvere incidenti funzionali.

• Laurea universitaria, EPFL, HEC, HEG o qualifica equivalente.

• Esperienza confermata come Senior Technical Business Analyst SAP S/4HANA con esperienza in FI/CO, MM e SD.

• Buona conoscenza delle applicazioni e dell'architettura SAP Fiori.

• Un'esperienza con Esker, SAP Concur e/o nel settore bancario è una risorsa.

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving, con la capacità di capire e rispondere a problemi aziendali.

• Ottima comunicazione e qualità relazionali.

• Inglese: attuale, sia per iscritto che orale.

• Francese: attuale.

• Residenza svizzera
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst SAP S/4HANA with strong functional and techno-functional expertise in Finance & Management Control (FI/CO), Product Management (MM), Sales & Distribution (SD) and the SAP Fiori ecosystem.
Key responsibilities

• Collect and analyse the business needs of internal stakeholders and propose solutions as close as possible to the standard features of SAP S/4HANA.

• Advise users on SAP S/4HANA good practices.

• Contribute to the definition of solutions that meet business needs while meeting SAP standards.

• Participate in SAP S/4HANA evolution and transformation projects.

• Set and customize FI modules (GL, AP, AR and AA), CO, MM and SD.

• Support UAT campaigns and contribute to release management activities.

• Ensure the quality, durability, scalability and sustainability of the solutions, respecting the product standards and the business needs defined by the customer.

• Maintain functional and technical documentation.

• Provide application support, diagnose problems and resolve functional incidents.

• University degree, EPFL, HEC, HEG or equivalent qualification.

• Experience confirmed as Senior Technical Business Analyst SAP S/4HANA with expertise in FI/CO, MM and SD.

• Good knowledge of SAP Fiori applications and architecture.

• An experience with Esker, SAP Concur and/or in the banking sector is an asset.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand and respond to business issues.

• Excellent communication and relational qualities.

• English: current, both in writing and oral.

• French: current.

• Swiss Residence

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your role:
As Lead Technique MDM Semarchy, you are the technical reference of our MDM offer and play a key role in the success of our customers' projects.
You are above all a hands-on profile, able to handle the most complex aspects of MDM projects while supervising more junior consultants.
You intervene from the pre-sales phases to the production of solutions and accompany the project teams on the aspects of architecture, implementation and technical governance.
You will also contribute to the upgrading of our consultants and the development of MDM expertise within Talan Switzerland.
Your responsibilities:
Expertise and technical leadership

• Design and implement MDM solutions based on Semarchy xDM / SDP .

• Define technical architectures and good development practices.

• Supervise master and reference data modeling choices.

• Ensure the technical quality of the solutions implemented.

• Perform architecture and code reviews.

• Support and support MDM development teams.

• Ensure that more junior consultants become competent.
Delivery projects

• Install and configure Semarchy platforms in customer environments.

• Participate in defining integration architectures with existing systems.

• Supervise complex developments and critical components.

• Ensure platform performance, security and sustainability.

• Support testing, migration and production phases.

• Provide a reference role on technical issues encountered during projects.
Customer advice and support

• Conduct technical workshops with trades and IT teams.

• Advise clients on good governance and data management practices.

• Accompany the definition of MDM roadmaps.

• Participate in the framing and business architecture phases related to Data Management.
Supply development and pre-sales

• Contribute to the development of Talan Switzerland's Data Management offer.

• Participate in customer support and demonstrations.

• Carry out estimates of charges and response files to calls for tenders.

• Contribute to the partnership with publisher Semarchy.

• Participate in monitoring actions and the dissemination of MDM expertise within the Swiss market.

Experience

• Minimum 8 years experience in implementing Data Management / Master Data Management solutions.

• Minimum 3 years of significant and demonstrable experience on Semarchy xDM .

• Experience with end-to-end MDM deployment projects.

• Experience in technical supervision of project teams.
Mandatory technical skills
Master Data Management

• Semarchy xDM solution expertise.

• Installation, setting and administration of the platform.

• MDM modelling.

• Workflow management.

• Data integration.

• Deployment and operation of MDM platforms.
Architecture and integration

• Application architecture and data architecture.

• REST API.

• Advanced SQL.

• Data integration and ETL.

• Cloud and hybrid environments.

• Multi-environment deployment.
Benefits

• Knowledge of Semarchy Data Platform (SDP).

• Experience with Data Quality or Data Governance tools.

• Knowledge of Azure Cloud, AWS or GCP environments.

• Experience in large-scale Data transformation programs.

• Semarchy certification.
Soft Skills

• Recognized technical leadership.

• Strong ability to challenge architectural choices.

• Excellent customer relationship.

• Spirit of counsel and pragmatism.

• Ability to work independently.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Taste for knowledge transfer and coaching.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il rappresentante per lo sviluppo aziendale è un membro chiave del team Vendite e Marketing. Si svolgerà un ruolo strategico nell'iniziare discussioni con potenziali clienti attraverso attività multicanale (chiamata fredda, e-mail, LinkedIn) per generare opportunità qualificate per Account Manager.
Come professionista autonomo, sei l'ambasciatore iniziale dell'esperienza di Talan sul mercato. La vostra perseveranza e le capacità di ascolto attive trasformeranno il freddo in appuntamenti qualificati, garantendo la crescita continua delle nostre unità aziendali.
La vostra missione coinvolge:

• Qualifica del piombo
• Lavorare come portiere tra le vendite e il marketing, i cavi di qualificazione provenienti dal marketing prima di inviarli alle vostre controparti di vendita.

• Di fronte al sito di Talan
• Come BDR, sei la prima persona prospettive di impegnarsi con quando si visita il nostro sito web. Sia attraverso telefono, forma o webchat, si impegna con prospettive interessate, qualificare e reindirizzare richieste.

• Sviluppo delle imprese
• Condurre attività di prospezione multicanale, tra cui chiamate fredde ai clienti mirati per generare interesse nelle offerte di Talan.

• Identificare, qualificare e tracciare le vendite porta secondo criteri stabiliti e pianificare appuntamenti qualificati per Account Managers.

• Eccellenza operativa e gestione prioritaria
• Mantenere un alto livello di attività quotidiane e settimanali per soddisfare e superare gli obiettivi della generazione di piombo, utilizzando strumenti disponibili.

• Assicurarsi che il CRM sia mantenuto aggiornato e mantenere i dati di qualità e fornire report periodici sulle prestazioni della campagna.

• Orientamento e condivisione delle conoscenze
• Adapt messaggistica e comunicazione in base all'interlocutore e alle informazioni strategiche raccolte (ascolto attivo) per massimizzare i tassi di conversione.

• Contribuisci all'efficacia della campagna suggerendo idee innovative e partecipando allo sviluppo di strategie GTM, script di chiamata e modelli di posta elettronica.

Obiettivo
Il vostro obiettivo primario è quello di generare tubo.
Tutto quello che fai genera SQLs per il team di vendita che si trasformerà in opportunità qualificate con un valore del tubo. Sia attraverso la prospettiva in uscita o la trasformazione di inbound conduce, il vostro unico scopo è quello di generare tubo di qualità che si evolverà in entrate.

Qualifiche
• Istruzione: BAC+4/5 in Business Administration o equivalente - 6 mesi Stage da settembre/ottobre 2026
• Eccellenza operativa: capacità dimostrata di gestire il tempo e le priorità in modo efficace per raggiungere obiettivi di generazione di piombo quantificabili.
• Abilità comportamentali: fiducia, dinamismo, perseveranza e curiosità intellettuale.
• Comunicazione: buone capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta, in francese e in inglese.
• Bonus - Technical Expertise: Proficienza con moderni strumenti di prospezione (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoominfo) e un CRM (Salesforce o equivalente).
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Business Development Representative is a key member of the Sales and Marketing team. You will play a strategic role in initiating discussions with potential clients through multi-channel activities (cold calling, emails, LinkedIn) to generate qualified opportunities for Account Managers.
As an autonomous professional, you are the initial ambassador of Talan's expertise in the market. Your perseverance and active listening skills will transform cold leads into qualified appointments, ensuring the continuous growth of our business units.
Your mission involves:

• Lead Qualification
• Work as a gatekeeper between sales & marketing, qualifying leads coming from marketing before sending them to your sales counterparts.

• Forefront of Talan’s website
• As BDR, you are the first person prospects engage with when visiting our website. Whether through phone, form or webchat, you engage with interested prospects, qualify and redirect enquiries.

• Business Development
• Conduct multi-channel prospecting activities, including cold calls to targeted clients to generate interest in Talan's offerings.

• Identify, qualify, and track sales leads according to established criteria, and schedule qualified appointments for Account Managers.

• Operational Excellence and Priority Management
• Maintain a high level of daily and weekly activities to meet and exceed lead generation objectives, utilizing available tools.

• Ensure the CRM is kept up-to-date and maintain quality data and provide regular reporting on campaign performance.

• Customer Orientation and Knowledge Sharing
• Adapt messaging and communication based on the interlocutor and strategic information gathered (active listening) to maximize conversion rates.

• Contribute to campaign effectiveness by suggesting innovative ideas and participating in the development of GTM strategies, call scripts, and email templates.

Objective
Your primary objective is to generate pipe.
Everything you do generates SQLs for the sales team that will then turn into qualified opportunities with a pipe value. Whether through outbound prospection or transforming inbound leads, your sole purpose is to generate quality pipe that will evolve into revenue.

Qualifications
• Education: BAC+4/5 in Business Administration or an equivalent degree - 6 months Internship from September/October 2026
• Operational Excellence: Demonstrated ability to manage time and priorities effectively to achieve quantifiable lead generation objectives.
• Behavioral Skills: Confidence, dynamism, perseverance, and intellectual curiosity.
• Communication: good oral and written communication skills, in French and English.
• Bonus - Technical Expertise: Proficiency with modern prospecting tools (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoominfo) and a CRM (Salesforce or equivalent).

• Ausbildung: BAC+4/5 in Betriebswirtschaft oder ein gleichwertiger Abschluss - 6 Monate Praktikum ab September/Oktober 2026

• Behavioral Skills: Vertrauen, Dynamik, Ausdauer und intellektuelle Neugier.

• Bonus - Technische Expertise: Kenntnisse mit modernen Prospektionstools (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoominfo) und einem CRM (Salesforce oder gleichwertig).
